video_title: Derik Queen On How Baltimore Shaped Him, Growing Up Fast & His Passions Beyond Basketball

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on how Baltimore's environment shaped his character and resilience
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it just made me to the person I am today like I got a little bit of grittiness
quotes.quote: A lot of people should have made it out that didn't or took the wrong path. We definitely do got a lot of talent, but it just made me to the person I am today. I got a little bit of grittiness right there, a little bit of hospitality. It's just different aspects of life definitely in Baltimore, but it's kind of all similar.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter and Derik Queen discuss the importance of hospitality and manners
quotes.excerpt: That man ain't got no hospitality. That man come in my house talking all kind of shit.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: That man ain't got no hospitality. That man come in my house talking all kind of shit. Don't take his shoes off and just go to talking crazy. No hospitality.

text_blocks.speaker: Derik Queen
text_blocks.text: No, you the one that started the craziness. You the one that started the craziness.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on growing up independently and staying true to his roots
quotes.excerpt: I left in me going to my 10th grade year so I kind of grew up faster living on my own
quotes.quote: I didn't spend my older years there. I left in me going to my 10th grade year so I kind of grew up faster living on my own. But I would never forget where I came from. I still eat the dollar noodles sometimes. Every time my mother come over here, she make me tuna. That's still my favorite snack or meal.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on the necessity of growing up fast when leaving home for basketball
quotes.excerpt: You got to grow up when you get away from your home, your comfort zone.
quotes.quote: You got to grow up when you get away from your home, your comfort zone. And I think for me, that really helped me grow faster than just being back home, being comfortable in that situation. It put me in a mind state of I know what I'm here for. It's a purpose. My purpose is basketball. That's why I'm here. So that is my focus.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen on his close relationship with his mother and her sacrifices
quotes.excerpt: My dad died when I was two so it just been me and my mother.
quotes.quote: My dad died when I was two so it just been me and my mother. We got even more tighter when I left. I remember one time she told me I couldn't go to a tournament because she didn't have it. This was like two weeks before and then she just started working overtime like so much to make it happen. I just really appreciated it for that.

quotes.speaker: Derik Queen
quotes.summary_phrase: Derik Queen's vision for a homeless shelter and hotel business in Baltimore
quotes.excerpt: I want to have like a shelter for homeless people and get them back on their feet.
quotes.quote: I want to have like a shelter for homeless people and get them back on their feet. But they work the shelter, but have like my mom or one of my closest friends or whoever the case may be oversee it. I want to own a hotel, CDL, what else? It just hurts my soul just seeing people like having no place to go.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter advises players to start planning for life after basketball early
quotes.excerpt: Start planning for your life after basketball, right? Because I know once you get to going in your career
quotes.quote: Start planning for your life after basketball, right? Because I know once you get to going in your career and you start making these All-Star games, you going to be so busy and your mind, you going to have so much. But I'm here to tell you, start planning on what you want to do after basketball. Write them down what you want to do and start every day. You're going to have so much free time and you know that. You got so much free time, just start working on it, bro.
